description: Schema for extracting key information from an invoice document.

issue_date.description: The date the invoice was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

due_date.description: The date the invoice payment is due, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vendor.description: Information about the vendor or seller.

name.description: Name of the vendor or seller.

address.description: Full address of the vendor or seller.

email.description: Contact email for the vendor or seller.

bill_to.description: Information about the customer being billed.

address.description: Full billing address of the customer.

line_items.description: List of individual items or services billed.

description.description: Description of the item or service.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item or service.

unit_price.description: Price per unit of the item or service.

amount.description: Total amount for the line item (quantity * unit price).

subtotal.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes and discounts.

tax.description: Details about the tax applied to the invoice.

rate.description: Tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 8.875 for 8.875%).

grand_total.description: The total amount due for the invoice, including subtotal and taxes.
